description: This file defines the ScreenStringRenderer interface, outlining methods for rendering various components of a screen in the ofbiz widget system, including containers, sections, content, and portal pages.

classes.name: ScreenStringRenderer
classes.description: Interface for rendering components of a screen within the ofbiz widget framework, defining methods for rendering different parts of a screen and associated widgets.

methods.name: getRendererName
methods.description: Returns the name of the renderer.

methods.name: renderSectionBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a section within a screen.

methods.name: renderScreenletSubWidget
methods.description: Renders a sub-widget within a screenlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnEnd
methods.description: Ends rendering a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBody
methods.description: Renders the body of a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletEnd
methods.description: Ends rendering a portal page portlet.
